aboutTitle: A small place for voluntary giving
about: JustGive is a personal contribution website built around one simple idea: people should be free to give when they wish, without pressure. Contributions are received by the website owner personally. There is no product, subscription, membership, investment, prize, or promised return. You receive a payment confirmation and a thank-you—not a purchased service or reward.
privacyAbusePrevention: To limit repeat appreciations, reports, and abuse, the server uses a keyed one-way hash of the network address and browser user-agent. Raw addresses are not stored. These hashes remain only while their associated message exists.
contactText: For questions about the website, contact the configured support address. No support email has been configured yet.
consentLabel: I explicitly consent to this message being considered for public display after moderation.

notConfigured: Payments are unavailable. No real payments can be accepted at this time.

legalReview: This document is a starting point and requires professional legal review before production launch.
noAdmin: Admin features require Supabase configuration and an administrator account.

giveSectionTitle: There's no one right way to give.
giveIntroTitle: Your kindness. Your feelings. Your choice.
giveIntroText: JustGive is a space to express your feelings, celebrate kindness and share a little happiness. Your contribution is entirely optional. Every small act comes from your own willingness, not expectation.
causeSubtitle: Choose what matters to you. You can skip this step.
ownerEthics: Beyond this space, we believe kindness should reach beyond words. The website owner aims to use personal resources responsibly and, whenever possible, support people facing hardship and animals in need. JustGive is not a charity or fundraising organisation. Its primary purpose is to give you a space to express your feelings and celebrate kindness.
